description: Critiques North Atlantic tidal resonance explanation for lunar recession anomaly

references.resonance_explanation: Standard ad hoc explanation in lunar science

ad_hoc_nature.description: Resonance explanation fitted post-hoc to explain 30% discrepancy
ad_hoc_nature.predictive_power: None - cannot predict future or past rates
ad_hoc_nature.testability: Low - requires knowing paleo-ocean geometry precisely

fine_tuning.description: Current North Atlantic geometry must be finely tuned to give exactly 2.25× amplification
fine_tuning.continental_configuration: Requires specific basin shape, depth, and coastline geometry
fine_tuning.sensitivity: Small changes in geometry produce large Q changes (unstable)

physical_mechanism.description: No physical model for how resonance modifies tidal dissipation
physical_mechanism.no_coupling_model: No theory linking continental drift to tidal Q

consistency.description: Resonance model conflicts with other observations
consistency.lunar_laser_ranging: Synodic residuals not explained by resonance
consistency.full_moon_deficit: Dust/thermal vs. resonance = separate ad hoc explanations

physical_mechanism.description: Dynamical φ field provides explicit coupling mechanism
physical_mechanism.g_eff_variation: G_eff = G × A(φ) varies with scalar field evolution
physical_mechanism.tidal_coupling: Q_eff depends on φ-mediated angular momentum transfer
physical_mechanism.prediction: Time-varying φ naturally produces changing recession rate

parsimony.tidal_dissipation_conundrum: Same φ evolution changes Q over geological time

testability.description: TEP makes specific predictions beyond post-hoc fitting
testability.perihelion_enhancement: Perihelion η = -2.8082e-04 versus aphelion subset; 1.42σ cosD-only differential (Step 022)

fine_tuning.description: TEP requires no fine-tuning of continental geometry
fine_tuning.suppression_density: ρ_c ≈ 20 g/cm³ from multiple independent probes
fine_tuning.universal_coupling: A(φ) applies to all matter universally

tep_model.free_parameters: Microscopic coupling α_0 constrained by Cassini to ≲ 3×10⁻³ (externally constrained)

verdict.conclusion: TEP provides superior explanation for lunar recession anomaly

resonance_model.future_recession: Cannot predict - continental drift too slow to measure
resonance_model.other_phenomena: None - model specific to recession rate only

tep_model.future_recession: φ continues evolving → rate may change
tep_model.past_recession: Higher G_eff in past → faster early recession

assessment.resonance_model: Ad hoc, untestable, requires fine-tuning, no predictive power
assessment.tep_model: Physical mechanism, testable, parsimonious, makes multiple predictions
